answer: Sequential Challenge Ladder. Each identity must solve a fresh challenge derived from the prior block's state, so answers cannot be precomputed or copied. A correct reply climbs one rung toward the ridge of eligibility; skipping or replaying any rung resets progress. Attacker cost is serial compute per identity with no batching shortcut, since each answer depends on the last. To reach the summit of full participation, a farm must pay that latency per account, making mass registration linear in time rather than cheaply parallel.
